title: loopActivity
responsibility: Derives pending and total step counts, last activity and age, stale status, and human-readable loop summary lines.

inputs.name: openStepCount.state
inputs.description: A LoopState with a steps array. Only entries whose status is exactly "pending" are counted.

inputs.name: isOpenLoop.state
inputs.description: A LoopState to classify. Any truthy closed value makes it closed; otherwise, openness depends on whether at least one step is pending.

inputs.name: loopActivity.state
inputs.description: A LoopState supplying step counts and candidate activity timestamps. The latest parseable truthy updatedAt, createdAt, or step.completedAt is used; absent or invalid timestamps can leave activity fields out.

inputs.name: loopActivity.now
inputs.description: Timestamp text parsed with Date.parse to calculate nonnegative whole-day age. If it does not parse, the result contains step counts only.

inputs.name: isStale.activity
inputs.description: Derived loop activity to compare with staleDays. Missing ageDays is stale; otherwise its value is compared directly, including for fractional or negative thresholds.

inputs.name: isStale.staleDays
inputs.description: Numeric threshold compared directly with ageDays in whole days. The function does not clamp or validate it.

inputs.name: loopSummaryLines.state
inputs.description: A LoopState whose counts and activity are summarized in text. A truthy closed object adds its status, closedAt, and reason as a line.

inputs.name: loopSummaryLines.now
inputs.description: Timestamp text parsed with Date.parse to calculate displayed age. If it does not parse, the summary reports age as unknown.

outputs.name: openStepCount
outputs.description: Count of steps whose status is exactly "pending"; steps with any other status are excluded.

outputs.name: isOpenLoop
outputs.description: Whether the state is not closed and has at least one pending step. Any truthy state.closed value makes the result false.

outputs.name: loopActivity
outputs.description: Contains pending-step and total-step counts, adding lastActivityAt and ageDays only when at least one activity timestamp and now parse successfully. Activity uses the latest updatedAt, createdAt, or step.completedAt; age is elapsed whole days, floored and clamped at zero.

outputs.name: isStale
outputs.description: True when ageDays is undefined or is greater than or equal to staleDays. The supplied threshold is compared directly.

outputs.name: loopSummaryLines
outputs.description: Includes lines for age since last activity and pending steps of total steps, with a closure line when state.closed is truthy. Age is unknown if no activity timestamp or now parses.
examples: Closed: abandoned at 2026-11-14T10:00:00.000Z - Replaced by a newer loop
